question: The Mediation Bill 2021, seeks to introduce mandatory pre-litigation mediation, requiring the attendance of parties in at least ________ mediation sessions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**two.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mediation Bill 2021**

 
 
• On** December 20, 2021**, the Mediation Bill, 2021 (the "Bill") was introduced in the **Rajya Sabha**. However, the Bill was sent to the **Committee on Law and Justice **for additional scrutiny because of significant opposition.
 
• **​**The purpose of the Bill is to** encourage, facilitate**, and** encourage **institutional mediation, in particular, as a means of resolving** commercial** and other types of disputes.
 
• A **Mediation Settlement Agreement (MSA) **will be the outcome of the mediation process and can be registered with the State district or taluk legal authorities within 90 days to guarantee authenticated records of the settlement. It will be enforceable under the law.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pre-litigation Mediation**

 
 
• **​**Due to the disappointment that litigation brings to the** parties,** there is a **growing interest i**n pre-litigation.
 
• Simply put, pre-litigation mediation aims to** resolve a dispute** before the formal legal process begins.
 
• Arguably, pre-litigation mediation is the **most empowering dispute** resolution strategy.
